name: Ka'imi Fairbairn

background.fact: Born January 29, 1994 in Kailua, Hawaii, to John and Rochelle Fairbairn. He has gone by Ka'imi since childhood; the name means 'seeker of wisdom' in Hawaiian.
background.confidence: from Wikipedia (data file bio agrees on birth date and birthplace)

background.fact: He attended Punahou School in Honolulu, where he was a two-sport star in football and soccer (two-time first-team all-state central defender; the soccer team won two state titles) and was teammates with DeForest Buckner.
At UCLA he won the kicking job as a true freshman in 2012, was a consensus first-team All-American as a senior, won the 2015 Lou Groza Award and became the Pac-12 career scoring record holder.
background.confidence: from Wikipedia; Lou Groza 2015 also in data file bio

background.fact: He signed with Houston as an undrafted free agent in 2016 and was named the starting kicker in 2017. Listed at 6 ft 0 in, 183 lb, age 32, jersey 15, depth chart K1.
Career field goal percentage of 87.9 percent, fourth most accurate kicker in NFL history per Wikipedia.
Regular season career in the data file: 146 games, 273 field goals made on 310 attempts, 57 made from 50 to 59 yards, 1 from 60 plus.
Contract in the data file: 4 years, $17.65 million total, $9 million guaranteed, signed 2020. The data file warns that later extensions are missing, so this may be outdated.
